name: Marriages
overview: Scripture presents marriage as a sacred and honorable union between a man and a woman, designed for lifelong commitment and unity, as seen in Genesis 2:24 where a man leaves his parents to become one flesh with his wife. It highlights the blessing and favor found in marriage (Proverbs 18:22) and calls for mutual love and respect between husband and wife (Ephesians 5:33). Furthermore, marriage is upheld as pure and honorable, with God judging those who engage in immoral behavior that defiles the marriage bond (Hebrews 13:4).
